name: Desktop Fix
notes: Fixes 0.1.0-12, where the desktop did not start after signing in. Everything from Stable Displays is included.
Windows stay on their own display when you use the menu bar, its dropdowns or Do Not Disturb.
A rebuilt display arranger: real sizes and positions, edge snapping, separate resolution and refresh rate, VRR, and Keep or Revert within 15 seconds.
GTK and GNOME windows, including save dialogs, follow Sovel's dark palette. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Sound lists are readable again.
The Sovel file picker replaces the GTK one for apps that use the portal, with places, drives, search, new folder and overwrite warnings.
A Downloads hub in the menu bar, completion notifications and Settings → Apps & Defaults → Downloads.
Drawing tablets: the pen controls its own display automatically, with Settings → Drawing Tablets for mapping, buttons, touch and active area.
